description: Adafruit's DHTtester, unmodified, reading a DHT22 on D2 every two seconds. The room (the project's world) is 23.4 C and 61.2 %RH from the start, and its temperature drops to -5.3 C at 3 s. Each read sends the sensor's previous measurement: the first two the room before the change; the third the one made as the second ended, about 1.03 s after the change, which the element's 10 s response time has brought to 23.4 - 28.7 (1 - e^(-1.03/10)) = 20.6 C; the fourth, two seconds on, 15.9 C.
